name: flobase-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Flobase unified schema files
author: Flobase Core Team

tools.name: read_schema
tools.description: Read and parse a Flobase schema.yaml file into structured JSON with an exhaustive human-readable summary of models, fields, and relationships.

tools.name: generate_er_diagram
tools.description: Deterministically generate a Mermaid.js Entity-Relationship diagram string representing models, field types, primary/foreign keys, and relational cardinality.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Validate a Flobase YAML document against Zod schemas and relational reference integrity. Resiliently handles malformed YAML without crashing.

tools.name: suggest_endpoints
tools.description: Derive suggested REST and GraphQL endpoints (CRUD and nested sub-resources) deterministically without external LLM calls.

resources.name: Flobase Document
resources.description: Access schema.yaml files discovered directly within the current active workspace
